news.headline:
Skipper Ltd's long-term credit rating upgraded to Crisil A/Stable.

Short-term bank facilities rating reaffirmed at Crisil A1 by Crisil Ratings.

Source: BSE

Top real estate developers may see mixed Q1FY27 results due to high base.

Demand for premium housing and branded developers remains strong despite timing challenges.

Source: Business Standard

Inventurus Knowledge Solutions executed loan agreements post TruBridge Inc. acquisition.

Subsidiaries and entities acted as borrowers; company issued a comfort letter for oversight.

Source: ScoutQuest

Oberoi Realty approved Rs. 135 Cr redemption of debentures via Cash Sweep Event.

Post redemption, debenture face value reduces from Rs. 83K to Rs. 56K; record date set as July 9, 2026.

Source: BSE

Coal India Ltd and UPRVUNL form JV for renewable energy projects.

JV focuses on solar, wind, pumped storage; CIL holds 51%, UPRVUNL 49%.

Source: ScoutQuest
